importDialog.columns: Tiirarka: Magaca, Lambarka taxanaha, Jinsiga, Da'da, Magaca fasalka, Qaybta, Taleefanka waalidka, Taleefan kale. Lambarrada taxanaha ee bannaan si toos ah ayaa loo buuxiyaa.

importDialog.fileUnreadable: Faylkaas lama akhrin karin. Hubi inuu yahay fayl CSV ah oo sax ah.
